stages.headline: Vectors that are not coplanar are called non-coplanar, e.g. the three edge vectors from one vertex of a cube.
stages.headlineEnglish: Vectors that are not coplanar are called non-coplanar, e.g. the three edge vectors from one vertex of a cube.

stages.headline: If a, b, c are non-coplanar, xa + yb + zc = 0 implies x = y = z = 0.
stages.headlineEnglish: If a, b, c are non-coplanar, xa + yb + zc = 0 implies x = y = z = 0.

stages.headline: The edge vectors DA, DB, DC from one vertex of a tetrahedron are non-coplanar.
stages.headlineEnglish: The edge vectors DA, DB, DC from one vertex of a tetrahedron are non-coplanar.

stages.headline: Can two of three non-coplanar vectors be collinear?
stages.headlineEnglish: Can two of three non-coplanar vectors be collinear?
stages.problemText: Can two of three non-coplanar vectors be collinear?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. Then all three would be coplanar.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. Then all three would be coplanar.
